newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE October white sugar freight differentials. [CORRECTED 00:30 GMT 6/8]
newsitem.headline: LIFFE October white sugar freight differentials. [CORRECTED 00:30 GMT 6/8]

text.p: The London International Financial and Options Exchange (LIFFE) issued new freight differentials for its white sugar contract to cover the October delivery period.

The exchange notice showed the following premiums Penang, Port Kelang and Singapore $2 (unchanged from August), Inchon $8 (unchanged), Ulsan $6 (unchanged), Bangkok/Kohsichang, Laemchabang/Sriracha $3 (unchanged) (corrects from "Laemchabang $3 (unchanged), Sriracha zero ($3)"), Guangzhou, Huangpu, Shekou, Xiamen $5 (unchanged), Recife, Maceio $8 (unchanged), Santos $16 (unchanged), Imbituba/Itajai $14 (unchanged), Buenos Aires $14 (unchanged), New Orleans, Savannah $11 ($13), Matanzas $15 ($17) and Durban $3 ($4).
